Read `editorial/CANON.md` before any editorial change. It is the owner's compact canon and the top written authority. Then read `music98-agent-operating-canon.md`, which only records how this repo applies the canon and does not override it. Automated checks are safety nets, not writing targets. A mechanical PASS is not prose certification. Manual checks are NOT RUN, never PASS. Do not save AI/PR/list-like/recap prose merely because tests pass.

## UI layout QA — blocking
Before changing layout, inspect every user screenshot and its annotations. Record what must move and what must remain fixed. Compare rendered desktop and mobile layouts against those screenshots, including header-to-heading and content-to-next-section distances, left/right edges, repeated element gaps, proportions and vertical alignment. Use existing site tokens and shared styles rather than arbitrary offsets. Do not move a player, map, heading or button that was not requested. Do not claim a visual QA pass from CSS/source inspection alone; if browser rendering was not checked, state that explicitly. When a visual defect is reported, correct the geometry, not only an isolated margin.
